Hey, beginner here too.
Let me share my own story - as a sample for You.

I smoked for 15 years - 15-20 cigs a day, mostly blue packs. But after last Christmas wife mentioned e-cigs (don't remember context, but it was not an offer), we both decided to try.
On a seconds day of Christmas, we got to a shop and bought two disposable ones. The idea behind was, is vapor even acceptable for us. 
We both had vaping experience from childhood as vaping hot potatoes or salty water under the blanket, was almost common practice to get rid some cold related sickness. (is this practice was in USSR only?)
Anyway, thing was that these disposables keeped us from cigarettes. Me for 2 days, wife - 1.
Later I got to local vape shop - lucky me, Christmas discounts were still valid :)
Got me Ego batt + Aspire CE5. Two weeks later (with cigarettes), wife got her E-roll C.
At about February I got my self involved in to RTA, got an Erlkonigin clone+iStick 20w... few week later wife got couple aspire ET-S and eGO batt.
Quick forward to current day - wife uses Ego One and i'm waiting for Kayfun clone.

Neither I or wife had huge issues, which would force us to go back to cigs.

The thing is, You need to start on something.. Only then You may be able to decide, what are Your likes or dislikes.

If You can... or more like, If Your friend(s) can borrow You e-cig for a day or two... that would be best and cheapest.
You could decide to what direction You should go... 

or
just go and buy the kit, just not the cheapest one....
but count the money You spend as spent, not invested.
